title: The rest of Paul’s letters: Philippians to Philemon
summary: Paul’s remaining letters are now on the site: Philippians, Colossians, 1 and 2 Thessalonians, 1 and 2 Timothy, Titus and Philemon. Each has a Plain English translation made from the Greek, study notes, the manuscript differences explained, notes on who it was first written for, and “Where Christians differ” cards on questions such as the rapture, the Antichrist, women in ministry, church order, Scripture and slavery. Older notes across the site that quote these letters now match the new translation.
